balance.notes: Existing own-power damage, defense, avoidance, critical, apocalypse reduction and damage caps are preserved; superiority is not a guaranteed win.

validation.priorFailedNewChecks: Three initial Overlord tests exposed missing intrinsic damage lookup. Added explicit intrinsic resolver; all three and affected X/Z/common damage regressions passed.
validation.pcAndMobile: Normal/three-cut/execution, area single/multi, server damage equality, pause/cancel, replacement identity, PVP exclusion, fixed idle and non-mirrored title passed; no console errors.
validation.fullBattleDamage: Each viewport: 220 normal receipts / 5917164 damage; 75 skill impacts / 2418096 damage; queue drained to zero.
validation.production: Eight production file hashes match; runtime catalog active/public at 62500000 PVE and zero PVP; foundation marker complete; X-BODY preserved at 50000000; no ownership grants.

release.integrated: Preserved nurse healing nerf 476ededc and deployment record b3a20820; rebuilt ten V3 consumers from merged source.
release.rationale: One new approved suit uses the established catalog and PVE rendering/scheduler extension points. No schema, transaction infrastructure, authentication, dependencies or launch gates were changed. Existing suit regressions and atomic catalog retry tests passed. Retain results for unchanged source and run final main-loader regression and required compiler/release/cache/Hyperdrive checks through designated scoped deployment.

runtimeCacheFix.rootCause: The main entry versioned the new engine but reused the pre-Overlord wrapper URL. That cached wrapper could reload its cached pre-Overlord engine. The readiness gate also accepted an already loaded old pair because they agreed with each other.
changes: Version lobby, engine and wrapper together with overlord=20261005-v2.
Require both wrapper and engine to match the lobby expected runtime.
Refresh native PVE and sustained PVE entry URLs, including the nested native loader.
preserved: Approved artwork, sword motion, title and aura
CMS balance; read-only live check found 75000000 PVE and preserved it

verification.before: All three checks failed; actual browser reproduced visible gun, no sword controller and no title using the historical wrapper and engine.
verification.after: Three cache checks passed. Actual lobby loader on PC/mobile selected Overlord V6; no generic gun; crimson aura and title visible; sword damage receipts replayed exactly (115176).
verification.live: Seven exact entry URL file hashes match production. Anonymous real production main shell loaded the paired runtime, then fixture-only rendering confirmed sword controller, hidden gun, crimson aura and the title. No player battle, rewards or writes were performed.

release.reason: Fix only battle entry cache compatibility for the approved Overlord; no assets, engine simulation, transactions or balance changes.

titlePlacement.behavior: Only Overlord hides the account nickname. The ornamental title now occupies the line just above the old nickname, with no extra 72-unit gap reserved for a second label.
titlePlacement.preserved: Approved title artwork, font, size, crimson aura, sword motion and server/CMS values are unchanged.

verification.production: Seven exact production entry URLs match. The actual production main loader rendered the title with nickname hidden, no gun and crimson aura; fixture-only anonymous check performed without player writes.

release.reason: Local Overlord title/name presentation only. Shared consumers rebuilt, paired runtime versions refreshed; actual PC/mobile label lifecycle and entry/cache regressions cover the change.

motionReform.behavior: Normal attack, three-cut combo and execution use the original complete authored timeline at 3.5x speed. Combo slash and impact sprites expand uniformly about their existing centers by 30%. Area anticipation and recovery accelerate around the unchanged authoritative five-hit contacts; total wall-clock cast duration is not divided by 3.5.
motionReform.preserved: Approved image/atlas bytes, body/title size, crimson aura, hidden nickname, CMS stats, damage receipts, area multiplier 6 and interval 18000ms.

implementation.renderer: Existing PixiJS sprites and GSAP timeline in OverlordSuitAnimation.js; model contact mapper in OverlordSuitModel.mjs
implementation.cleanup: Only Overlord opts into a shorter effect duration. Pending damage receipts still prevent disposal; other skill lifetimes are unchanged.

verification.presentation: Slash and impact dimensions are exactly 1.3x with fixed centers and no cumulative scaling. Body/title scale unchanged. Pause/resume, receipt equality and effect cleanup passed without page errors.
verification.fullBattle: Each viewport replayed all 220 normal receipts / 5917164 damage and 75 skill hits / 2418096 damage; queue drained to zero with no remaining effects or page errors.

release.reason: Local Overlord presentation timing and combo effect size; ten shared V3 consumers rebuilt with paired cache tokens. No simulation, server, transaction, balance or asset changes. PC/mobile receipt replay and related motion/cache/entry regressions cover the affected paths.
